procedures.name: Offline file URLs, standalone and original native import
actions: Set the real browser context offline.
Open each of the five standalone demo/index.html file URLs and click run.
Open the untouched original portal file URL and import all five through its native Add Case directory input.
Click run in each original-portal sandbox.
Refresh after cumulative import, read the saved five ids, revisit all five demos and click run again.
